# ShowUpAI

> ShowUpAI is an AI-powered webinar attendance booster that helps webinar hosts double their attendance rates from 31% to 62%+.

## What ShowUpAI Does

ShowUpAI generates 8-touch AI-written reminder sequences for webinars, delivered across email, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Circle.so, Facebook, and Instagram. Users approve the copy before anything is sent.

## Key Features

- AI generates 8 personalised touches per webinar (confirmation, insight, poll, case study, thought-provoking, reminder, post-event, FOMO)
- Multi-channel delivery: Email, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Circle.so, Facebook, Instagram
- Approval queue: review and approve before sending
- Works with any webinar platform: Zoom, Teams, Google Meet, Circle.so, Eventbrite, Luma
- 3-week warmup campaign with dynamic scheduling
- Image generation: carousel, infographic, quote card

## Target Audience

Webinar hosts, community managers, event marketers, B2B companies running educational webinars, UK school business managers.
